events.title_en: A Garden of Thoughts: Ali Taptık
events.description_tr:
Fotoğraf : Ali Taptık, ”Bir bitki örtüsüne doğru ”, 2010 – süregelen bir seri

Galata Rum Okulu’nun Açık Okul Kütüphanesinde yer alan Reysi Kamhi’nin sergisi ”Düşünce Bahçesi” kapsamında yer alacak okuma serilerinin dördüncüsü Ali Taptık yönetiminde 15 Haziran Çarşamba saat 18.00-19.00 arasında gerçekleşecek.

Ali Taptık, “Bir bitki örtüsüne doğru” isimli süre gelen çalışması kapsamında yaptığı okumalardan bölümler paylaşacak.

Taptık okuma seansında, J.G. Ballard’ ın distopik romanı “Drowned World”, Katja Gringer’ in doktora çalışmasını temel alarak yayınladığı “Ramble, linger and gaze – dialogues from Landscape Garden” ve Peter del Tredici’ nin kentte kendiliğinden yetişen bitkileri konu alan makalesi “Spontaneous Urban Vegetation: Reflections of Change in a Globalized World” ile bitkilerle ilişkilerimiz üzerine birlikte düşünmeye davet ediyor.

Okuma dili İngilizce, konuşma dili Türkçedir.
events.description_en:
Photograph: Ali Taptık, "Towards a Flora," 2010–ongoing

The fourth session of the reading series held in conjunction with Reysi Kamhi’s exhibition “A Garden of Thoughts” at the Open School Library of the Galata Greek School was led by artist and photographer Ali Taptık on Wednesday, June 15, 2016 from 18:00 to 19:00.

Sharing readings from his ongoing artistic research project “Towards a Flora,” Ali Taptık invited participants to reflect on our relationship with urban flora through J.G. Ballard’s dystopian novel “The Drowned World,” Katja Grillner’s doctoral work “Ramble, Linger and Gaze: Dialogues from the Landscape Garden,” and Peter Del Tredici’s essay “Spontaneous Urban Vegetation: Reflections of Change in a Globalized World.”

Readings in English; discussion in Turkish.
events.description_el:
Φωτογραφία: Ali Taptık, «Προς μια Χλωρίδα» (Bir Bitki Örtüsüne Doğru), 2010 – εν εξελίξει σειρά

Η τέταρτη συνάντηση της σειράς αναγνώσεων στο πλαίσιο της έκθεσης της Reysi Kamhi «Κήπος της Σκέψης» στην Ανοιχτή Σχολική Βιβλιοθήκη της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά πραγματοποιήθηκε την Τετάρτη 15 Ιουνίου 2016 (18:00–19:00) με τον φωτογράφο και εικαστικό Ali Taptık.

Μέσα από την εν εξελίξει ερευνητική του εργασία «Προς μια Χλωρίδα», ο Ali Taptık μοιράστηκε αποσπάσματα από το δυστοπικό μυθιστόρημα του J.G. Ballard «Ο Βυθισμένος Κόσμος» (The Drowned World), τη μελέτη της Katja Grillner «Ramble, Linger and Gaze: Dialogues from the Landscape Garden» και το δοκίμιο του Peter Del Tredici «Spontaneous Urban Vegetation: Reflections of Change in a Globalized World», προσκαλώντας το κοινό σε έναν στοχασμό για τη σχέση μας με την αυτοφυή αστική χλωρίδα.

Γλώσσα ανάγνωσης: Αγγλική • Γλώσσα συζήτησης: Τουρκική

events.title_tr: İstanbul'un Yeni Tarihi: 8500 yıl önce Yenikapı'da Yaşam
events.title_en: The New History of Istanbul: Life in Yenikapı 8,500 Years Ago
events.title_el: Η Νέα Ιστορία της Κωνσταντινούπολης: Η Ζωή στο Γενίκαπι πριν από 8.500 Χρόνια
events.description_tr:
29 Ocak Çarşamba günü, saat 18:30’da Tarih Vakfı’nın ‘Yine, Yeni: Dünya Kenti İstanbul’ sergisi etkinlikleri çerçevesinde Emine Çaykara ile iki bölüm halinde Yenikapı kazılarıyla ortaya çıkan yaşamı konuşacağız.

”İstanbul’un Yeni Tarihi: 8500 yıl önce Yenikapı’da Yaşam;” Prof. Vedat Onar ile birlikte.

İlk yaşam neredeydi? Ne yediler? Nasıl yaşadılar? Ayakizleri bize ne anlatıyordu? Alanda neden pek çok iskele çıktı? Botanik buluntuları neyi işaret ediyordu? 60 binin üzerinde kemik incelemesinde hangi hayvanlar çıktı? 55 hayvan türü bize eski İstanbullular hakkında ne diyordu?

5 Şubat’ı da not edin, bu defa Evren Türkmenoğlu ile Denizcilik, Teknoloji ve Yaşam: Bulunan 37 gemi batığı hangi özellikleri taşıyordu? Nasıl batmışlardı? İstanbul’a ne getiriyor ne amaçla kullanılıyorlardı? Gemi batıkları nasıl çıkarıldı, restorasyonu ve sergilenmeleri ne kadar zaman alacak?
events.description_en:
On Wednesday, January 29, 2014 at 18:30, as part of the public program of the History Foundation’s (Tarih Vakfı) exhibition “Again, New: World City Istanbul,” writer Emine Çaykara hosted a two-part conversation on the prehistoric life revealed by the Yenikapı excavations.

Part I (January 29) — “The New History of Istanbul: Life in Yenikapı 8,500 Years Ago” with Prof. Dr. Vedat Onar:
Where did the earliest settlement begin? What did Neolithic inhabitants eat and how did they live? What do the preserved 8,500-year-old footprints tell us? Why were numerous wooden piers uncovered at the site? What did the botanical findings and the analysis of over 60,000 animal bones across 55 species reveal about ancient Istanbulites?

Part II (February 5) — “Seafaring, Technology, and Life” with Evren Türkmenoğlu:
What were the characteristics of the 37 Byzantine shipwrecks uncovered in the Harbor of Theodosius? How did they sink, what cargoes did they carry to Constantinople, and how are they being conserved and prepared for exhibition?

events.title_el: Πρώτη προβολή του ντοκιμαντέρ "Η Απώλεια της Πατρίδας" του Aydın Kapancık.
events.description_tr:
KOSMETİO FUKARAPERVER VAKFI / ATİNA ve GALATA RUM OKULU, yönetmen Aydın Kapancık’ın “KAYIP VATAN” belgesel filminin ilk gösterimine Cuma 18 Mart 2016, Saat 19.00 davet etmekten onur duymaktadır.

Kosmetio Vakfı 1970 yıllında İstanbullu Rum Kimon ve Maria Kosmeto ailesinin hibesi neticesinde kurulmuş, evsiz ve aciz, yurtlarından istekleri dışında ayrılmış olan İstanbullu Rumlara kirasız bark ve sosyal destek sağlamaktadır. Film Vakfın etkinlikleri ile İstanbullu Rumların 1950 yıllından bugüne olan tarihini beraber sunmaktadır.

Film dili Türkçe’dir ve İngilizce alt yazı olacaktır.
events.description_en:
THE KOSMETEIO PHILANTHROPIC FOUNDATION OF ATHENS ('Home of the Constantinopolitan') and THE GALATA GREEK SCHOOL are honored to invite you to the premiere screening of the documentary film "LOST HOMELAND" (Kayıp Vatan) directed by Aydın Kapancık on Friday, March 18, 2016 at 19:00.

Established in 1970 through the endowment of the Constantinopolitan Greek family of Kimon and Maria Kosmeto, the Kosmeteio Foundation provides rent-free housing and social care to displaced Constantinopolitan Greeks in need. The documentary presents the Foundation's work alongside the history of the Greeks of Istanbul from the 1950s to the present day. Screened in Turkish with English subtitles.
events.description_el:
ΤΟ ΦΙΛΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΚΟ ΚΟΣΜΕΤΕΙΟ ΙΔΡΥΜΑ ΑΘΗΝΩΝ «Οίκος του Κωνσταντινουπολίτη» και Η ΣΧΟΛΗ ΓΑΛΑΤΑ Σας Προσκαλούν στην πρώτη Προβολή της Ταινίας Ντοκιμαντέρ: «Η ΑΠΩΛΕΙΑ ΤΗΣ ΠΑΤΡΙΔΑΣ» του Aydın Kapancık την Παρασκευή 18 Μαρτίου 2016, ώρα 19.00

Το Κοσμέτειο Ίδρυμα λειτουργεί από το 1970 μετά από την ευεργεσία της Πολίτικης οικογένειας Κίμωνα και Μαρίας Κοσμέτου προσφέροντας δωρεά στέγη και μέριμνα στους αναξιοπαθούντες εκπατρισμένους Κωνσταντινουπολίτες. Η ταινία συνδυάζει τις δραστηριότητες του Ιδρύματος και την ιστορία της Ρωμιοσύνης της Πόλης μετά από το 1950.

events.title_tr: Misela'nın 15. yılı şerefine Alphan Eşeli’den "Crafting Realms" AI sergisi.
events.title_en: Crafting Realms" AI-driven exhibition by Alphan Eşeli for Misela’s 15th anniversary.
events.title_el: Έκθεση AI "Crafting Realms" του Alphan Eşeli για τη 15η επέτειο της Misela.
events.description_tr:
Serra Türker Bayır’ın kurucusu olduğu Misela’nın 15 yıllık serüvenine bir övgü niteliği taşıyan ve yönetmen Alphan Eşeli’nin vizyonuyla zanaatkarlığı yaratıcılıkla buluşturan “Crafting Realms” sergisi okulumuzda gerçekleşti

Sergiye tasarımlarıyla hayat veren Alphan Eşeli ‘Bu proje insan yaratıcı zekası ve yapay zekanın bir araya geldiğinde nasıl bir evren yaratabileceğinin göstergesi. Bu açıdan bu proje aslında bizi nasıl bir geleceğin beklediğine dair de bir projeksiyon. 15 senelik yolculukta ve bu sergide emeği geçen herkese canı gönülden teşekkür etmek istiyorum’ diyerek yapay zekanın sanat alanında yeni kapıları araladığına dikkat çekti.

Sanat ve moda arasındaki ilişkiyi yeniden tanımlayarak gelenek ve yeniliği bir araya getiren, konsepti ve tasarımı ‘74STUDIO tarafından gerçekleştirilen sergi, Misela’nın ustalıkla işlenmiş tasarımlarını yapay zekanın sınırsız imkanlarıyla birleştirirken, izleyiciyi geçmişle geleceğin arasında büyüleyici bir yolculuğa davet ediyor.

Ödüllü yönetmen Alphan Eşeli’nin yapay zeka kullanımıyla şekillendirdiği 15 eser, Misela’nın ikonik tasarımlarından hareketle gelenek ve yenilik arasında bir ilişki kurarak yaratıcı ifadenin sınırlarını zorlamayı amaçlıyor. “Crafting Realms” sergisindeki her eser, 15 Misela tasarımından ilham alarak, 15 kadının ve 15 şehrin ruhunu kurgusal bir gerçeklik içinde ele alıyor.
events.description_en:
The “Crafting Realms” exhibition, which pays tribute to the 15-year journey of Misela, founded by Serra Türker Bayır and combines craftsmanship with creativity under the vision of director Alphan Eşeli, took place at our school.

Alphan Eşeli, who brought the designs to life in the exhibition, stated, “This project is an indication of what kind of universe can be created when human creative intelligence and artificial intelligence come together. In this respect, this project is actually a projection of what the future holds for us. I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has contributed to this journey of 15 years and to this exhibition.”

Redefining the relationship between art and fashion, the exhibition, conceptualized and designed by ’74STUDIO, merges Misela’s meticulously crafted designs with the boundless possibilities of artificial intelligence, inviting the audience on a fascinating journey between the past and the future.

Shaped by award-winning director Alphan Eşeli’s use of artificial intelligence, the 15 pieces aim to push the boundaries of creative expression by establishing a relationship between tradition and innovation, starting from Misela’s iconic designs. Each artwork in the “Crafting Realms” exhibition takes inspiration from 15 Misela designs, portraying the essence of 15 women and 15 cities within a fictional reality.
events.description_el:
Στο σχολείο μας πραγματοποιήθηκε η έκθεση "Crafting Realms", η οποία είναι ένας φόρος τιμής στη 15χρονη περιπέτεια της Misela, που ιδρύθηκε από τη Serra Türker Bayır, και συνδυάζει τη δεξιοτεχνία με τη δημιουργικότητα με το όραμα του σκηνοθέτη Alphan Eşeli.

Ο Alphan Eşeli, ο οποίος έδωσε ζωή στην έκθεση με τα σχέδιά του, είπε: «Αυτό το έργο είναι μια ένδειξη του είδους του σύμπαντος που μπορεί να δημιουργηθεί όταν η ανθρώπινη δημιουργική νοημοσύνη και η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη ενώνονται. Από αυτή την άποψη, αυτό το έργο είναι στην πραγματικότητα μια προβολή του τι είδους μέλλον μας περιμένει. «Θα ήθελα να ευχαριστήσω ολόψυχα όλους όσοι συνέβαλαν στη 15χρονη διαδρομή και σε αυτή την έκθεση», είπε, επισημαίνοντας ότι η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη έχει ανοίξει νέες πόρτες στον χώρο της τέχνης.

Συνδυάζοντας την παράδοση και την καινοτομία επαναπροσδιορίζοντας τη σχέση τέχνης και μόδας, η έκθεση, της οποίας το concept και το σχέδιο υλοποιήθηκαν από το '74STUDIO, συνδυάζει τα αριστοτεχνικά σχεδιασμένα σχέδια της Misela με τις απεριόριστες δυνατότητες της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και προσκαλεί τον θεατή σε ένα συναρπαστικό ταξίδι μεταξύ του παρελθόντος και του μέλλοντος.

Τα 15 έργα, που διαμορφώθηκαν από τον βραβευμένο σκηνοθέτη Alphan Eşeli με τη χρήση τεχνητής νοημοσύνης, στοχεύουν να ξεπεράσουν τα όρια της δημιουργικής έκφρασης εγκαθιδρύοντας μια σχέση μεταξύ παράδοσης και καινοτομίας, με βάση τα εμβληματικά σχέδια της Misela. Κάθε έργο στην έκθεση «Crafting Realms» είναι εμπνευσμένο από 15 σχέδια Misela και αποτυπώνει το πνεύμα 15 γυναικών και 15 πόλεων σε μια φανταστική πραγματικότητα.

events.title_tr: Yankılar: Zaman ve Mekân Boyunca Şiddet (Reverberations)
events.title_en: Reverberations: Violence Across Time and Space
events.title_el: Αντηχήσεις: Η Βία στον Χρόνο και τον Χώρο (Reverberations)
events.description_tr:
Bu konferans şiddet ve sonrasının incelenmesi için yeni kavramlar üretmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Şiddetin mekan, zaman ve diğer boyutlarda, hem insanın içselliği hem de özneler arasılığı içinde ve ötesinde kalıcı dağılımına ve yansımalarına odaklanan yenilikçi etnografik çalışmaları davet ediyoruz. Özellikle şiddet araştırmalarında insanı merkezi konumundan uzaklaştırmanın potansiyelleri ve tehlikeleri nelerdir diye sormak istiyoruz. Peki şiddetin post-hümanist analizi nasıl olabilir?

Bugüne kadar şiddet üzerine yapılan pek çok çalışma, hümanist felsefelerden ilham alan insan merkezli bir çerçeveyi varsaymıştır. İnsan benliğine ve bedenine (bireysel ya da kitlesel ölçekte) uygulanan şiddet, böylece birincil kaygıyı oluşturdu ve 'öznellik' teorilerinin araçlarından yararlanan kavramsallaştırmaları doğurdu. Bu şekilde uygulanan ve teorileştirilen kavramlar, 'travma'dan 'melankoli'ye, 'yas'a, 'nostaljiye', 'kayıp'a ve 'acı çekmeye' kadar uzanır ve 'bellek çalışmaları' versiyonları aracılığıyla paketlenir. Öte yandan, dil ve temsilin sınırlarını devreye sokarak ve Bedenlerin ve teknolojilerin ötesindeki ve ötesindeki yer değiştirmeleri ve tepkileri takiben, şiddet üzerine yapılan çalışmalar aynı zamanda insan nosyonlarını yapısöküme uğratma ve karmaşıklaştırma hamlelerine de katıldı. Bu doğrultudaki bilim adamları, şiddetin zaman, mekan ve maddiyatlar boyunca 'yıkım' olarak erişimini ve aynı zamanda 'unutulmazlık' yoluyla ortaya çıkan mistik doğaüstü hayaletleri keşfetmeye başladılar.

Foucault, insan vücudunda işkence yoluyla açılan yaraların ötesinde, mekân, zaman, kurumlar ve düzenlemelerdeki şiddeti analiz eden tartışmasız ilk post-hümanist filozoftu. Bu konferans, şiddet araştırmalarında duygulanım kuramından ve yeni materyalizmlerden kaynaklanan daha güncel diğer meydan okumaları dikkate alarak bu post-hümanist gidişatın üzerine inşa etmeyi amaçlıyor. Ancak bunu yaparken, herhangi bir açık teorik yönelimi veya yörüngeyi savunmayı amaçlamıyoruz; bunun yerine farklı çerçevelerin güçlü ve zayıf yönlerinin tartışılması için bir alan yaratmayı amaçlıyoruz. Dolayısıyla, özellikle insan öznelliğine odaklanan şiddet araştırmaları içindeki hümanist miraslarla eleştirel bir ilişki, 'öznelliği dışarıya dağıtma' konusundaki güncel post-hümanist yaklaşımların nasıl olduğu üzerine düşüncelerle eşleştirilebilir.

(Latour) ise tam tersine bedeni, özneler arasılığı ve toplumsal cinsiyeti keşfetme konusunda başarısız oldu.

Akademisyenleri, uzun süre, mekânsal genişleme ve şiddet dolu geçmişlerin maddi yansımaları üzerine tarihsel ve etnografik olarak spesifik vakalar aracılığıyla yeni kavramlar, çerçeveler ve araştırma modları üretmeyi hedeflediğimiz eleştirel tartışma alanına davet ediyoruz. Bu doğrultudaki etnografyalar, çevreye, atmosfere, havaya, doğaya, insanların doğaüstü varlıklarla ilişkilerine, nesnelerine, mekanlarına, yapılı çevrelerine, teknolojilerine ve diğer rasyonelliklere ve aynı zamanda birbirleriyle olan ilişkilerine sızan şiddeti açıklayabilir. Bu tür çalışmalar, şiddeti fail ve mağdur arasındaki asimetrik özneler arası ilişki içinde tekil bir çerçeveye oturtmadan, şiddet içeren çapraz kesişen ilişkilere (insan bedeni-çevre-maddilik-uzay-zaman) odaklanacaktır. Bunun yerine şiddeti maddelerden, alanlardan, kurumlardan ve özneler arası ilişkilerden geçerken, şiddetin nasıl yeniden şekillendiğini, başka kimyalara nasıl büründüğünü veya yeni kalıp ve şekillerde nasıl ortaya çıktığını inceleyeceklerdi. Tarihsel ve etnografik, analizleri, soyut yerine spesifik şiddet kavramsallaştırmalarının geliştirilip tartışılacağı şekilde yönlendirecektir.

Düzenleme Komitesi: Yael Navaro-Yashin, Zerrin Özlem Biner, Alice von Bieberstein, Seda Altuğ

Sergi Küratörü: Emrah Gökdemir

REMNANTS projesi, Sosyal Antropoloji Bölümü, Cambridge Üniversitesi

Sponsor: Avrupa Araştırma Konseyi (ERC) ve Cambridge Üniversitesi Sosyal Antropoloji Bölümü
events.description_en:
This conference aims to generate new concepts for the study of violence and its aftermath. We invite innovative ethnographic studies that attend to the enduring distribution and reverberation of violence across space, time and other dimensions, both in and beyond the interiority and inter-subjectivity of the human being. Specifically we would like to ask what are the potentials and dangers of displacing the human from its central position within studies of violence? And, what can a post-humanist analysis of violence look like?

Many studies on violence to date have assumed an anthropocentric framework inspired by humanist philosophies. Violence done to the human self and body (on an individual or massive scale) has thereby formed the primary concern and engendered conceptualizations drawing on tools of theories of ‘subjectivity.’ Concepts thus applied and theorized range from ‘trauma’ to ‘melancholia,’ ‘mourning,’ ‘nostalgia,’ ‘loss,’ and ‘suffering,’ unpacked via versions of ‘memory studies.’ On the other hand, by engaging the limits of language and representation and by following displacements and responses across and beyond bodies and technologies, studies on violence have also partaken in moves to deconstruct and complicate notions of the human. Scholars in this vein have begun to explore the reach of violence across time, space and materialities as ‘ruination,’ as well as its mystical supernatural apparitions via ‘haunting’.

Foucault was arguably the first post-humanist philosopher to analyse violence in spaces, time, institutions, and regulations, beyond the wounds inflicted through torture upon the human body. This conference aims to build upon this post-humanist trajectory by taking on board, in the study of violence, other more recent challenges from affect theory and the new materialisms. In doing so, however, we do not aim to advocate any clear theoretical orientation or trajectory, but instead to create a space for the discussion of the strengths and weaknesses of different frameworks. A critical engagement with humanist legacies within studies of violence that focus singularly on human subjectivity might thus be matched by reflections on how recent post-humanist approaches, in ‘distributing subjectivity outside’

(Latour) have, in reverse, failed to explore the body, inter-subjectivity, and gender.

We invite scholars into a space for critical discussion where we aim to generate new concepts, frameworks and modes of enquiry through historically and ethnographically specific cases on the longue durée, spatial expanse and material reverberations of violent pasts. Ethnographies in this vein could account for violence as it seeps into the environment, the atmosphere, air, nature, people’s relations with supernatural beings, with their objects, spaces, the built environment, technologies and other rationalities, as well as with each other. Such studies would attend to criss- crossing relations that involve violence (human body-environment- materiality-space-time) without singularly framing violence in the asymmetrical inter-subjective relation between perpetrator and victim. Instead they would study violence as it crosses substances, fields, institutions, and inter-subjective relations, how violence gets reconfigured, how it assumes other chemistries or appears in new moulds and shapes. The historical and the ethnographic will drive the analyses invited such that specific rather than abstract conceptualizations of violence are developed and discussed.

Organizing Committee: Yael Navaro-Yashin, Zerrin Ozlem Biner, Alice von Bieberstein, Seda Altug

Exhibition Curator: Emrah Gokdemir

REMNANTS project, Department of Social Anthropology, University of Cambridge

Sponsored by: European Research Council (ERC) and the Department of Social Anthropology, University of Cambridge
events.description_el:
Το διεθνές συνέδριο «Αντηχήσεις: Η Βία στον Χρόνο και τον Χώρο» (Reverberations: Violence Across Time and Space) αποσκοπεί στη διαμόρφωση νέων εννοιολογικών εργαλείων για τη μελέτη της βίας και των μακροχρόνιων συνεπειών της. Προσκαλεί καινοτόμες εθνογραφικές μελέτες που εξετάζουν τη διαρκή διάχυση και αντήχηση της βίας στον χώρο, τον χρόνο και την υλικότητα, τόσο εντός όσο και πέραν της ανθρώπινης εσωτερικότητας και διυποκειμενικότητας, θέτοντας το ερώτημα ποιες είναι οι δυνατότητες και τα όρια μιας μετα-ανθρωπιστικής ανάλυσης της βίας.

Ενώ η πλειονότητα των μελετών γύρω από τη βία βασίστηκε παραδοσιακά σε ανθρωποκεντρικά πλαίσια — αναλύοντας έννοιες όπως το «τραύμα», η «μελαγχολία», το «πένθος», η «νοσταλγία», η «απώλεια» και η «οδύνη» μέσα από τις σπουδές μνήμης — νεότερες προσεγγίσεις διερευνούν την εμβέλεια της βίας στον χρόνο, τον χώρο και την υλικότητα ως «ερείπωση» (ruination) και ως φασματική επιβίωση του παρελθόντος (haunting).

Αξιοποιώντας τη συμβολή του Michel Foucault καθώς και σύγχρονες προκλήσεις από τη θεωρία του συναισθήματος (affect theory) και τους νέους υλισμούς (new materialisms), το συνέδριο προσκαλεί ακαδημαϊκούς σε έναν χώρο κριτικού διαλόγου μέσα από ιστορικά και εθνογραφικά τεκμηριωμένες μελέτες περίπτωσης στη μακρά διάρκεια (longue durée).

Οργανωτική Επιτροπή: Yael Navaro-Yashin, Zerrin Özlem Biner, Alice von Bieberstein, Seda Altuğ
Επιμελητής Έκθεσης: Emrah Gökdemir
Πρόγραμμα REMNANTS, Τμήμα Κοινωνικής Ανθρωπολογίας, Πανεπιστήμιο του Κέιμπριτζ
Υποστήριξη: Ευρωπαϊκό Συμβούλιο Έρευνας (ERC) & Τμήμα Κοινωνικής Ανθρωπολογίας του Πανεπιστημίου του Κέιμπριτζ

events.title_en: The Image and Beyond: Domenikos Theotokopoulos
events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu, 23 Nisan – 14 Haziran tarihleri arasında, Domenikos Theotokopoulos’un 400. ölüm yıldönümü dolayısı ile kendi bünyesinde düzenlediği ilk araştırma bazlı sergi olan ”İmge ve Ötesi: Domenikos Theotokopoulos” u İstanbullu sanatseverlere gururla sunar.

”İmge ve Ötesi:Domenikos Theotokopoulos” sanat tarihinde çoğunlukla El Greco olarak bilinen Domenikos Theotocopoulos’un bilinmeyen ikonograf kimliğine odaklanarak, aynı zamanda esas olarak dinsel tasvir’in ötesinde bir anlama ve derin bir felsefeye sahip olan ikona ile görünmez yaratıcısı olan ikonografların dünyasına ışık tutmaktadır. İzleyiciyi fiziksel dünyadan tinsel alana taşıyan ikonalar, ”görünmeyeni” görünür kılan bir araç niteliğindedir. İkonograflar ise , bu imgelerin sessiz yaratıcıları olarak, görünmeyen, içsel olan bu alanı görmemizi sağlayan ve bu dünyayı yaratımları aracılığı ile ortaya çıkararkan sanatçılardır. Sanat tarihi boyunca geçmişten bugüne birçok sanatçıyı derinden etkilemiş olan Domenikos Theotokopoulos Girit doğumlu olup, yaşamının ilk dönemlerinde Venedikte sanatsal pratiğinin ilk adımı olan ikonografiye yoğunlaşmış ve Bizans ikona geleneğini benimseyerek ileriki dönemlerinde gerçekleştirdiği resimlerinde de bu görsel dilin ışığında pratiğini dönüştürmüştür.

Görünmeyen olanın kapılarını aralayan Domenikos Theotokopoulos’un ikonograf kimliğini keşfederken, aynı zamanda içerisine bulunduğumuz coğrafyanın sosyo kültürel belleğinin de bir parçası olan ikona sanatının bilinmeyen yönlerine ışık tutan sergi’nin akademik danışmanlığını Işık Üni. öğretim üyesi Prof.Dr.Eva Aleksandru Şarlak ve küratörlüğünü Hera Büyüktaşçıyan gerçekleştirmektedir. Galata Rum Okulu bünyesinde gerçekleşen ve Hollanda Başkonsolosluğu’nun MATRA İnsan Hakları fonu ile desteklenen bu dokümanter serginin araştırması ve içeriği Adil Öztürk, Ruhiye Onurel (ROŞ), Kültürel Mirası Koruma Merkezi’nden Selen Erken ve Cansu Kuman tarafından gerçekleştirilmiştir.
events.description_en:
Galata Greek School proudly presents its first research-based exhibition, "Image and Beyond: Domenikos Theotokopoulos", to Istanbul art lovers, between 23 April and 14 June, on the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the death of Domenikos Theotokopoulos.

"Image and Beyond: Domenikos Theotocopoulos" focuses on the unknown iconographer identity of Domenikos Theotocopoulos, mostly known as El Greco in art history, and also sheds light on the world of the icon, which has a meaning and a deep philosophy beyond the religious depiction, and the iconographers who are its invisible creators. Icons, which transport the viewer from the physical world to the spiritual realm, are a tool that makes the "invisible" visible. Iconographers, on the other hand, are artists who, as the silent creators of these images, enable us to see this invisible, internal space and reveal this world through their creations. Domenikos Theotokopoulos, who has deeply influenced many artists from past to present throughout the history of art, was born in Crete, and in the early periods of his life, he concentrated on iconography, which was the first step of his artistic practice in Venice, and by adopting the Byzantine icon tradition, he transformed his practice in the light of this visual language in his paintings in the following periods.

Işık University is the academic advisor of the exhibition, which explores the iconographer identity of Domenikos Theotokopoulos, who opened the doors of the invisible, and sheds light on the unknown aspects of icon art, which is also a part of the socio-cultural memory of the geography we live in. It is curated by Prof. Dr. Eva Aleksandru Şarlak and curated by Hera Büyüktaşçıyan. The research and content of this documentary exhibition, which was held within the Galata Greek School and supported by the MATRA Human Rights fund of the Dutch Consulate General, was carried out by Adil Öztürk, Ruhiye Onurel (ROŞ), Selen Erken and Cansu Kuman from the Cultural Heritage Preservation Center.
events.description_el:
Έκθεση με τίτλο «Εικόνα και το πέραν της εικόνας: Δομίνικος Θεοτοκόπουλος» που αφορά μια μελέτη στο έργο του μεγάλου ζωγράφου, έχει την τιμή να παρουσιάσει η Σχολή Γαλατά από τις 23 Απριλίου έως τις 15 Ιουνίου 2014 με αφορμή την ανακήρυξη του 2014 ως έτους «Δομήνικου Θεοτοκόπουλου» για τη συμπλήρωση 400 χρόνων από το θάνατο του μεγάλου Κρητικού ζωγράφου.

Η έκθεση «Εικόνα και το πέραν Αυτής: Δομίνικος Θεοτοκόπουλος» που περιλαμβάνει άγνωστες πτυχές του καλλιτεχνικού ιδιώματος του διάσημου ζωγράφου, γνωστού στο ευρύ κοινό με το όνομα Ελ Γκρέκο, επιχειρεί να αναδείξει μέσα από τις εικόνες που κατέχουν ένα βαθύ φιλοσοφικό νόημα και υπόσταση πέρα από τα όρια της απλής θρησκευτικής απεικόνισης, τον αθέατο δημιουργικό κόσμο της εικονογραφίας.

Οι εικόνες έχοντας την ιδιότητα να κάνουν το αόρατο ορατό ανυψώνουν τον θεατή από τον πραγματικό στον πνευματικό κόσμο. Ιδιαίτερα στην εικονογραφία, ως αθόρυβοι δημιουργοί αυτών των εικόνων, οι καλλιτέχνες, μέσω της απεικόνισης αυτού του κόσμου μας επιτρέπουν να δούμε αυτή την αόρατη, βαθειά εσωτερική τους πλευρά.

Γεννημένος στην Κρήτη και έχοντας ζήσει τα νεανικά του χρόνια στη Βενετία, ο Δομίνικος Θεοτοκόπουλος, λειτούργησε ως καταλύτης για τη σύγχρονη τέχνη από το παρελθόν μέχρι τις μέρες μας. Αφιερώνοντας την πρώιμη καλλιτεχνική του παραγωγή στην εικονογραφία και επηρεασμένος από τη βυζαντινή τεχνοτροπία μεταμόρφωσε, υπό το φως αυτής της εικαστικής γλώσσας, το ύφος στις εικόνες της επόμενης περιόδου επηρεάζοντας την εξέλιξη της ζωγραφικής του 19ου και 20ου αιώνα.

Η έκθεση επιχειρεί να σκιαγραφήσει την καλλιτεχνική ταυτότητα του Δομίνικου Θεοτοκόπουλου που καταπιάνεται με το υπερβατικό, ενώ ταυτόχρονα αναδεικνύει άγνωστες πτυχές της εικονογραφίας η οποία αποτελεί σημαντικό κομμάτι της κοινωνικό-πολιτιστικής κληρονομιάς της γεωγραφικής περιοχής μας.

Η έκθεση που διοργανώνει η Σχολή Γαλατά υλοποιείται με τη στήριξη του προγράμματος MATRA για τα ανθρώπινα δικαιώματα του Ολλανδικού Προξενείου. Την ευθύνη για την έρευνα και επιστημονική επιμέλεια της έκθεσης έχει η καθηγήτρια του Πανεπιστημίου Işık κ. Εύα Σαρλάκ και η επιμέλεια ανήκει στην Ήρα Büyüktaşçıyan . Επίσης, στο κομμάτι της έρευνας και περιεχομένου της έκθεσης συνεργάστηκαν η Adil Öztürk και η Ruhiye Onurel (ROŞ) καθώς και από το Κέντρο Προστασίας Πολιτιστικής Κληρονομιάς η Selen Erken και η Cansu Kuman.

events.title_en: “Grape Juice” Exhibition
events.description_tr: İtalyan Büyükelçiliği, İtalyan Kültür Merkezi ve AlbumArte işbirliği ile gerçekleşen ”Anteprima” misafir sanatçı programı kapsamında davet edilen Flavio Favelli’nin sergisi ”Grape Juice” 17 Mayıs – 14 Haziran 2014 tarihleri arasında Galata Rum Okulu/ büyük salon’da görülebilecek.
events.description_en: Invited as part of the "Anteprima" artist-in-residence program organized in collaboration with the Embassy of Italy, the Italian Cultural Institute in Istanbul, and AlbumArte, Italian artist Flavio Favelli's exhibition "Grape Juice" was presented in the Grand Hall of the Galata Greek School from May 17 to June 14, 2014.
events.description_el: Στο πλαίσιο του προγράμματος φιλοξενίας καλλιτεχνών «Anteprima», που πραγματοποιήθηκε σε συνεργασία της Πρεσβείας της Ιταλίας, του Ιταλικού Μορφωτικού Ινστιτούτου και του οργανισμού AlbumArte, η έκθεση του Ιταλού καλλιτέχνη Flavio Favelli με τίτλο «Grape Juice» παρουσιάστηκε στη μεγάλη αίθουσα της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά από τις 17 Μαΐου έως τις 14 Ιουνίου 2014.

events.title_tr: Tuzlu Su: Düşünce Biçimleri Üzerine Bir Teori
events.title_en: 14th Istanbul Biennial — "SALTWATER: A Theory of Thought Forms"
events.title_el: 14η Μπιενάλε της Κωνσταντινούπολης — «ΑΛΜΥΡΟ ΝΕΡΟ: Μια Θεωρία για τις Μορφές Σκέψης»
events.description_tr:
14. İstanbul Bienali için hazırlıklar tüm hızıyla devam ediyor. Carolyn Christov-Bakargiev tarafından TUZLU SU: Düşünce Biçimleri Üzerine Bir Teori başlığıyla bir dizi işbirliği içerisinde şekillenmeye devam eden 14. İstanbul Bienali, 5 Eylül – 1 Kasım 2015 tarihleri arasında şehre dalga dalga yayılacak.

Ücretsiz olarak gezilebilecek 14. İstanbul Bienali, 30’un üzerinde noktada iki ay boyunca düşüncenin alabildiği sayısız farklı formun özel bir yelpazesiyle izleyicilere sunulacak. Bienalde, 60’ın üzerinde sanatçının yanı sıra aralarında denizbilimci, hikâye anlatıcısı, matematikçi ve nörobilimcilerin de bulunduğu diğer katılımcılar, kolektif ve zamansız bir ortak düşünme deneyinde buluşacaklar. Bienalde, düşüncenin alabileceği formlar matematikle, fenle, bitkilerle ve sanatla içiçe araştırılacak. Bienal kapsamında aynı zamanda paneller ve okuma günleri gibi etkinliklerin olduğu kamusal program ile film programı da düzenlenecek.

Ayrıntılı bilgi için: http://bienal.iksv.org/tr
events.description_en:
Curated by Carolyn Christov-Bakargiev under the title “SALTWATER: A Theory of Thought Forms,” the 14th Istanbul Biennial spread across the city from September 5 to November 1, 2015, with the Galata Greek School serving as one of its principal exhibition and public program venues.

Open to the public free of charge across more than 30 locations on both sides of the Bosphorus, the 14th Istanbul Biennial brought together over 60 artists alongside oceanographers, writers, mathematicians, and neuroscientists in a collective inquiry into the forms that thought can take—intertwining art with mathematics, natural sciences, botany, and maritime history.
events.description_el:
Σε επιμέλεια της Carolyn Christov-Bakargiev με τίτλο «ΑΛΜΥΡΟ ΝΕΡΟ: Μια Θεωρία για τις Μορφές Σκέψης» (TUZLU SU / SALTWATER: A Theory of Thought Forms), η 14η Μπιενάλε της Κωνσταντινούπολης εξαπλώθηκε σε ολόκληρη την πόλη από τις 5 Σεπτεμβρίου έως την 1η Νοεμβρίου 2015, με την Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά ως έναν από τους κεντρικούς εκθεσιακούς και δημόσιους χώρους της.

Με ελεύθερη είσοδο σε περισσότερα από 30 σημεία της πόλης, η 14η Μπιενάλε της Κωνσταντινούπολης έφερε σε διάλογο πάνω από 60 καλλιτέχνες και άλλους συμμετέχοντες — μεταξύ των οποίων ωκεανογράφοι, συγγραφείς, μαθηματικοί και νευροεπιστήμονες — διερευνώντας τις μορφές που λαμβάνει η σκέψη στη διασταύρωση της τέχνης με τα μαθηματικά, τις φυσικές επιστήμες και τη βοτανική.

events.title_en: Days (Günler) — Ahmet Doğu İpek
events.description_tr:
Ahmet Doğu İpek’in İstanbul’daki ikinci kişisel sergisi “Günler”, Galata Rum Okulu’nda gerçekleşiyor. Binanın birinci ve ikinci katlarına yayılan sergi, İpek’in son 10 ayda ürettiği yapıtların yanı sıra 2015’e tarihlenen eserlerini de barındırıyor.

Serginin birinci katında yer alan yerleştirme, Galata Rum Okulu’nun yerleşkesi olan binanın tarihsel, mimari ve işlevsel hafızasına odaklanıyor. Yaklaşık 140 m²’lik bir alana yayılan bu çalışma, mekanın zemin ve duvarlarının mimari bir müdahale ile yeniden şekillendirilmesinden oluşuyor. Simgesel bir mekan tasviri olan yerleştirme; eğim, kütle, ağırlık gibi somut verilerin yanı sıra hakikat, algı, inkar gibi olgulara da işaret ediyor.

Serginin hem omurgasını oluşturan hem de ona ismini veren “Günler” serisi, 200’den fazla suluboya eserden meydana geliyor. 2016 Temmuz ayının sonlarında başlayan ve 2017 Mart ayına kadar devam eden bir süreçte her gün bir resmin eklenmesiyle büyüyen ve her bir resmin üretildiği günün hafızasını taşıdığı bu siyah soyut seriden yaklaşık 120 parça sergileniyor.

Bir anlamda “Günler”in evrildiği nokta olarak ortaya çıkan “Yıldızlar” adlı çalışma ise siyah bir kağıt yüzeye atılmış çentiklerden oluşuyor. Çocuksu bir arayışla ışığın izini süren ve performatif bir sürecin sonunda ortaya çıkan resim, sergide tam olarak “Günler”in bittiği yerde karşımıza çıkıyor.

Yine bu sergi için üretilen “Repair” serisi ise kendiliğinden oluşan doğal formların algoritmasını anlama ve bunları taklit etme çabası üzerine kurulu. Çatlamış ve dağılmaya yüz tutmuş kaya kütlelerini küçük bir müdahaleyle iyileştirmek, parçalarını bir arada tutmak, onları simgesel olarak tamir etmek ve işlevsel olarak hiçbir yararlılığı olmayan bir şeye anlam yüklemek gibi fikirler etrafında gezinen bu seriden üç parça sergide yer alıyor.

Birçoğu izleyiciyle ilk kez buluşacak bu yapıtların yanı sıra, sanatçının önceki yıllarda ürettiği “Black Water Records”, “İkinci Hasat” ve “Construction Regime” serilerine ait daha önce sergilenmemiş işlerini, bir heykel yerleştirmesini de görmek mümkün olacak.

Sergi Tasarımı: Nevzat Sayın Afiş Tasarımı : Okay Karadayılar
events.description_en:
Ahmet Doğu Ipek’s second solo show in Istanbul, “Days” takes place in Galata Greek School. Spread on the first and second floors of the venue, the exhibition includes works Ipek produced in the last 10 months, as well as works dated to 2015.

The installation on the first floor of the venue focuses on the historical, architectural and functional memory of the building of the Galata Greek School. Spreading over an area of approximately 140 m², this installation is based on reshaping the floor and walls with an architectural intervention. This work, which is a symbolic description of the space, points to facts like slope, mass, weight as well as phenomena such as truth, perception, denial.

The “Days” series, composed of more than 200 watercolor works, each symbolizing the memory of the day it was produced, not only constitutes the spine of the exhibition but also gives its name to it. Started in late July 2016 and continuing through March 2017, approximately 120 pieces of this black abstract series are included in the show.

“Stars”, which emerged as the point where “Days” evolved, consists of notches thrown on a black paper surface. Result of a performative process, this painting with a childish quest for the light, meets the viewer at the edge of the installation carrying “Days”.

The “Repair” series produced for this exhibition is based on an effort to understand and imitate the algorithm of natural forms. There are three premiere exhibits that circumnavigate ideas such as repairing cracked and disintegrated rock masses with a small intervention, keeping their pieces together, symbolically repairing them, and making sense of something that is not functionally useful.

In addition to these works, many of which will be exhibited for the first time, unseen works from previous series “Black Water Records”, “Second Harvest” and “Construction Regime” and a sculptural installation can be seen in the show.

Exhibition Design: Nevzat Sayın Exhibition Poster Design: Okay Karadayılar
events.description_el:
Η δεύτερη ατομική έκθεση του Ahmet Doğu İpek στην Κωνσταντινούπολη, με τίτλο «Ημέρες» (Günler), παρουσιάστηκε στην Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά. Εκτεινόμενη στον πρώτο και τον δεύτερο όροφο του ιστορικού κτιρίου, η έκθεση περιλαμβάνει έργα που δημιούργησε ο καλλιτέχνης τους τελευταίους δέκα μήνες, καθώς και επιλεγμένες συνθέσεις από το 2015.

Η εγκατάσταση του πρώτου ορόφου εστιάζει στην ιστορική, αρχιτεκτονική και λειτουργική μνήμη του κτιρίου της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά. Αναπτυγμένο σε επιφάνεια περίπου 140 τ.μ., το έργο αναδιαμορφώνει το δάπεδο και τους τοίχους της αίθουσας μέσω μιας αρχιτεκτονικής παρέμβασης, παραπέμποντας τόσο σε απτά φυσικά μεγέθη —όπως η κλίση, η μάζα και το βάρος— όσο και στις έννοιες της αλήθειας, της αντίληψης και της άρνησης.

Η σειρά «Ημέρες», που αποτελεί τον κεντρικό άξονα της έκθεσης, απαρτίζεται από περισσότερες από 200 ακουαρέλες, από τις οποίες εκτίθενται περίπου 120 έργα. Η σειρά ξεκίνησε στα τέλη Ιουλίου 2016 και ολοκληρώθηκε τον Μάρτιο του 2017 με την προσθήκη ενός έργου κάθε ημέρα, ώστε κάθε σύνθεση να φέρει τη μνήμη της ημέρας δημιουργίας της. Εκτίθενται επίσης το έργο «Αστέρια» (Yıldızlar), η σειρά «Επισκευή» (Repair), καθώς και ανέκδοτα έργα από τις ενότητες «Black Water Records», «Δεύτερη Συγκομιδή» και «Καθεστώς Κατασκευής».

Αρχιτεκτονικός σχεδιασμός έκθεσης: Nevzat Sayın | Σχεδιασμός αφίσας: Okay Karadayılar

events.title_en: These Are Not Fables, Children — Ekin Saçlıoğlu
events.title_el: Αυτά Δεν Είναι Μύθοι, Παιδιά — Ekin Saçlıoğlu
events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu, 4 Mart- 1 Nisan 2017 tarihleri arasında Ekin Saçlıoğlu’nun 8. Kişisel sergisine ev sahipliği yapıyor.

Saçlıoğlu’nun ‘Bunlar Fabl Değil Çocuklar’ adlı sergisi milyonlarca yıl dünyada yaşamış ancak günümüzde soyu tükenmiş ya da tükenmeye yüz tutmuş canlılara, nesli tükendi zannedilse de halen varoluş mücadelesi veren hayvan türlerine ve yaşayan fosil bitkiler gibi daha nicelerinin hikayelerine yer veriyor.

Desenlerin, resimlerin, heykellerin, bitkilerin, yosunların ve çeşitli yerleştirmelerin yer aldığı sergide, Saçlıoğlu, Galata Rum Okulu’nun taşıdığı geçmişe referansla, çok sayıda çocuğun belleğinde yer etmiş bu mekânı, açık bir kitaba dönüştürüyor, bilinen ve bilinmeyen kayıpların peşine düşüyor, izleyiciyi yaşayan bir fablın içine girmeye davet ediyor.

Sanatçı, gerçek hikâyelerden yola çıktığı anlatılarında, tarihten günümüze doğa – insan ilişkisini, varoluş ve yok oluş kavramlarını nesli tükenmekte olan türler üzerinden konu edinmekte. İnsanoğlunun, kendisine karşı bir tehlike olarak gördüğü yabanıl hayatı, kontrol altına alma arzusu ile yok edici bir güç gösterisine dönüşen, öldürülmüş hayvanlarla fotoğraf çektirme merakı, Saçlıoğlu’nun resim ve desenlerine esin kaynağı oluyor. Soyu tükendiği sanılan Anadolu

Leoparından, sayıca oldukça azalmış Anadolu Vaşağına, farklı zaman dilimlerinden gelen ancak benzer geçmişe sahip türler karşımıza çıkmakta.

Soyunun tek örneği olarak 2012’de ölen ‘Yalnız George’ isimli kaplumbağanın birebir ölçülerde yapılmış kabuk replikası, sergide ‘yok olmaya’, ‘yuvayı terk etmeye’ dair bir metafor olarak düşünülebilir.

1800 yıllık bir antik kabartmada betimlenen Anadolu leoparı, sanatçının bir heykelinin esin kaynağı olurken sergideki bir başka çalışma, dünyada sadece üç tane kalmış olan Beyaz Kuzey Gergedanını konu alıyor. Gergedanlar, portreleri ile birer insan gibi kişiselleşiyorlar.

‘Bunlar Fabl Değil Çocuklar’ okulun sınıflarında artık yer almayan çocuklara ve izleyicilere bu görsel hikâyelerin birer fabl olmadığını söylese de, aslında bütün bu anlatıların metaforlar ve alegoriler üzerine kurulu olduğunun ve bazen, kimi gerçeklikleri anlatabilmek için alegori ve metaforlara başka zamanlardan daha çok ihtiyaç duyduğumuzun altını çizmekte.

Evet bunlar fabl değiller, ancak hikayelerimiz de sadece hayvanlara ait değil…
events.description_en:
From March 4 to April 1, 2017, the Galata Greek School hosted Ekin Saçlıoğlu’s 8th solo exhibition, “These Are Not Fables, Children” (Bunlar Fabl Değil Çocuklar).

Bringing together drawings, paintings, sculptures, living plants, moss, and site-specific installations, Ekin Saçlıoğlu's exhibition tells the stories of creatures that inhabited the Earth for millions of years before becoming extinct or endangered, alongside living fossil plants and species struggling for survival. Referencing the educational past of the Galata Greek School—a building etched in the memories of generations of children—the artist transforms the venue into an open book, inviting viewers to step inside a living fable.

Drawing on true stories, Saçlıoğlu examines the relationship between humanity and nature: from the Anatolian Leopard (depicted in an 1,800-year-old ancient relief) and the endangered Anatolian Lynx to a life-size replica of the shell of "Lonesome George" (the Pinta Island tortoise that died in 2012 as the last of its subspecies, serving here as a metaphor for disappearance and leaving home) and individualized portraits of the last three Northern White Rhinoceroses on Earth.

While "These Are Not Fables, Children" reminds viewers and the absent schoolchildren of the historic classrooms that these visual stories are real rather than fables, it underscores how deeply we rely on allegory and metaphor to confront urgent ecological and historical realities. Indeed, these are not fables—yet our stories do not belong solely to animals...
events.description_el:
Από τις 4 Μαρτίου έως την 1η Απριλίου 2017, η Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά φιλοξένησε την 8η ατομική έκθεση της εικαστικού Ekin Saçlıoğlu με τίτλο «Αυτά Δεν Είναι Μύθοι, Παιδιά» (Bunlar Fabl Değil Çocuklar).

Περιλαμβάνοντας σχέδια, ζωγραφικά έργα, γλυπτά, φυτά, βρύα και εγκαταστάσεις, η έκθεση της Ekin Saçlıoğlu αφηγείται τις ιστορίες ειδών που έζησαν στη Γη επί εκατομμύρια χρόνια αλλά σήμερα έχουν εξαφανιστεί ή απειλούνται με εξαφάνιση, καθώς και «ζωντανών απολιθωμάτων» του φυτικού βασιλείου. Με αναφορά στο εκπαιδευτικό παρελθόν της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά —ενός χώρου χαραγμένου στη μνήμη γενεών παιδιών— η καλλιτέχνιδα μεταμορφώνει το κτίριο σε ανοιχτό βιβλίο, αναζητώντας γνωστές και άγνωστες απώλειες.

Βασισμένη σε αληθινές ιστορίες, η Saçlıoğlu εξετάζει τη σχέση ανθρώπου και φύσης: από την Ανατολική Λεοπάρδαλη (εμπνευσμένη από αρχαίο ανάγλυφο 1.800 ετών) και τον απειλούμενο Λύγκα της Ανατολίας έως το πιστό αντίγραφο σε φυσικό μέγεθος του καβουκιού της χελώνας «Μοναχικός Τζορτζ» (Lonesome George, που πέθανε το 2012 ως το τελευταίο δείγμα του είδους του, αποτελώντας μεταφορά για την εξαφάνιση και τον αποχωρισμό από την εστία) και τα προσωποποιημένα πορτρέτα των τριών τελευταίων Βόρειων Λευκών Ρινόκερων στον πλανήτη.

Αν και ο τίτλος «Αυτά Δεν Είναι Μύθοι, Παιδιά» υπενθυμίζει στους θεατές και στους απόντες μαθητές των ιστορικών αιθουσών ότι οι οπτικές αυτές ιστορίες είναι αληθινές, αναδεικνύει παράλληλα την ανάγκη της αλληγορίας και της μεταφοράς για την κατανόηση της πραγματικότητας. Ναι, αυτά δεν είναι μύθοι — όμως οι ιστορίες μας δεν αφορούν μόνο τα ζώα...

events.title_en: Utopia — Kirkor Sahakoğlu
events.description_tr:
“Algılanan ve gerçek” kavramının resim hali…

Galata Rum Okulu, 26 Mayıs 2017’den itibaren Kirkor Sahakoğlu’nun “UTOPIA” projesine ev sahipliği yapacak. Sahakoğlu uzun yıllardır hazırlandığı bu sergide Adorno’nun “Hakikatin yalan, yalanın da hakikat gibi göründüğü bir dönemeçteyiz şimdi.” özdeyişinden yola çıkmış. Sanatçı, özellikle son elli yılda, sahicilikten uzak yaşamlarımızın bizleri adeta bir illüzyon sahnesine hapsettiğini, bu tutulmadan uyandıktan sonra ise bir daha asla eskiye geri dönemeyecek oluşumuzu anlatıyor. Kendisi bu distopiadan kaçıp, karşı kıyılarda bir ütopya arayışına girerek çözüme ulaşmaya çalışıyor. Bütün bunları yaparken öz yaşamından kesitlere gidiyor. Gerçek bir mekanın içerisinde bulunan birden fazla zaman ve uzamı vurgulayan Foucault’un “Heterotopya”sının bir ucu yaşamını şekillendiren buradaki sokaklara, diğer ucu ise karşı kıyılara uzanıyor. Yarattığı bu ütopyada başka bireyleri beslemeye, insanlarla paylaşmaya, denize, Zorba’ya, nedensiz güvenmeye, toleransla pişmanlık duymamaya, sevgiye, Yannis Ritsos’a, Azra Erhat’a, Heredot’a sıkça rastlıyor.

İstanbul doğumlu olan Kirkor Sahakoğlu, Getronagan Lisesi’nin ardından Devlet Tatbiki Güzel Sanatlar Yüksek Okulu Reklam Grafiği Bölümü’nden mezun oldu. Daha sonra Milano’da Istituto Europeo Di Design’da master’ını tamamladı. Domus Academy’de bir süre eğitim aldı ve atölyelere katıldı. 1985 yılından itibaren Türkiye’nin önde gelen reklam ajanslarında sanat yönetmenliği ve yaratıcı yönetmenlik yaptı. Ardından kendi ajansını kurdu. Markalaşma sürecinde pek çok kuruma ve ürüne destek verdi. Reklamcılığı süresince çok sayıda Kristal Elma ödülü kazandı. 2010 yılından bu yana serbest çalışan, ajanslara ve kuruluşlara danışmanlık yapan Sahakoğlu, Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi Grafik Sanatlar Bölümü’nde de ders veriyor. Çeşitli üniversitelerde seminerler ve atölyeler düzenliyor. Kirkor Sahakoğlu 2014 yılında Tütün Deposu’nda “Dildilian Kardeşlerin objektifinden Bir Ermeni Ailesinin Yitik Geçmişine Tanıklıklar 1872-1923” adlı serginin küratörlüğünü üstlendi. Çeşitli sergilerde çalışmaları yer alan sanatçı, 2015 yılında Tütün Deposu’nda “EKSİK” isimli ilk kişisel sergisini açtı.
events.description_en:
Illustrating the concept of “Perceived and Reality”

Galata Greek School is going to host Kirkor Sahakoglu’s “UTOPIA” exhibition opening on 26th of May 2017. Sahakoglu has been working on this exhibition for a long time and influenced by Adorno’s quote “It has come to the point that lies sound like truth, and truth like lies.”. The artist explains how our lives drifting away from reality confined us into an illusionary state especially in the last fifty years and indicates even though we wake up from this trance we will never be able to get back to it. He revisits fragments of his personal past when he sets out to find an utopia across the shore while trying to escape from this distopia. With references to Foucault’s “Heterotopia” which explains multiple times and dimensions coexisting simultaneously in one physical place, his work expands from the streets in İstanbul that gave direction to his life reaching across the shore. He comes across feeding others, sharing with people, the sea, Zorba, trusting without reason, tolerance without regret, love, Yiannis Ritsos, Azra Erhat, and Heredotus in the utopia he created.

Born in Istanbul, Kirkor Sahakoglu studied at the Getronagan High School, after which he graduated from the School of National Applied Fine Arts Advertising Graphics Department. Later he received his master’s degree at Istituto Europeo Di Design in Milan. He also studied at Domus Academy and participated in workshops. As of 1985, Sahakoglu worked as art director and creative director in prominent advertising agencies of Turkey, and later founded his own agency. He assisted numerous institutions and products in their branding processes. Recipient of innumerable Crystal Apple awards of the Association of Advertising Agencies, since 2010 Sahakoglu has been working freelance as a consultant for agencies and organizations, as well as teaching undergraduate and graduate students at Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts. He also organizes seminars and workshops in various universities. Kirkor Sahakoglu curated “Bearing Witness to the Lost History of an Armenian Family Through the Lens of the Dildilian Brothers (1872-1923)” exhibition at Tütün Deposu in 2014. After collaborating in various exhibitions over the years, he opened his first solo exhibiton “Absent” at Tütün Deposu in 2015.
events.description_el:
Η εικαστική αποτύπωση της έννοιας του «αντιληπτού και του πραγματικού»…

Από τις 26 Μαΐου 2017, η Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά φιλοξένησε την έκθεση «UTOPIA» του Kirkor Sahakoğlu. Σε αυτή την έκθεση, την οποία προετοίμαζε επί σειρά ετών, ο καλλιτέχνης ξεκινά από τη ρήση του Theodor Adorno: «Βρισκόμαστε πλέον σε μια καμπή όπου η αλήθεια μοιάζει με ψέμα και το ψέμα με αλήθεια». Ο Sahakoğlu πραγματεύεται πώς η αποξενωμένη από την αυθεντικότητα ζωή των τελευταίων πενήντα ετών μάς έχει εγκλωβίσει σε μια σκηνή ψευδαίσθησης και πώς, αναζητώντας διέξοδο από αυτή τη δυστοπία, στρέφεται στην αναζήτηση μιας ουτοπίας στις απέναντι ακτές μέσα από θραύσματα της προσωπικής του μνήμης.

Αντλώντας από την έννοια της «Ετεροτοπίας» του Michel Foucault — η οποία αναδεικνύει τη συνύπαρξη πολλαπλών χρόνων και τόπων μέσα σε έναν πραγματικό χώρο — το έργο του εκτείνεται από τους δρόμους της Κωνσταντινούπολης που διαμόρφωσαν τη ζωή του έως τις απέναντι ακτές. Σε αυτή την ουτοπία συναντά κανείς το μοίρασμα με τους ανθρώπους, τη θάλασσα, τον Ζορμπά, την ανιδιοτελή εμπιστοσύνη, την ανεκτικότητα χωρίς μεταμέλεια, την αγάπη, τον Γιάννη Ρίτσο, την Azra Erhat και τον Ηρόδοτο.

Γεννημένος στην Κωνσταντινούπολη, ο Kirkor Sahakoğlu αποφοίτησε από το Αρμενικό Λύκειο Getronagan και στη συνέχεια από το Τμήμα Γραφιστικής της Κρατικής Ανωτάτης Σχολής Εφαρμοσμένων Καλών Τεχνών, ενώ ολοκλήρωσε μεταπτυχιακές σπουδές στο Istituto Europeo di Design και στην Domus Academy στο Μιλάνο. Από το 1985 εργάστηκε ως καλλιτεχνικός και δημιουργικός διευθυντής σε κορυφαίες διαφημιστικές εταιρείες, τιμήθηκε με πολυάριθμα βραβεία Kristal Elma και διδάσκει στο Τμήμα Γραφικών Τεχνών της Σχολής Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου Μαρμαρά. Το 2014 επιμελήθηκε στο DEPO (Tütün Deposu) την έκθεση «Μαρτυρίες για το Χαμένο Παρελθόν μιας Αρμενικής Οικογένειας μέσα από τον Φακό των Αδελφών Dildilian (1872–1923)» και το 2015 παρουσίασε στον ίδιο χώρο την πρώτη του ατομική έκθεση με τίτλο «EKSİK» (Έλλειψη / Absent).

events.title_en: And Only the Stones Remained
events.description_tr:
“Ve Sadece Taşlar Kaldı” 20.yüzyıl Yunan şiirinin büyük ustalarından Yannis Ritsos’un Yiaros ve Leros adalarındaki sürgün dönemi ve sonrasında yaşadığı Samos’ta resmettiği taşlarından küçük bir seçkiyi Galata Rum Okulu’nun Açık Okul Kütüphanesi’nde izleyici ile buluşturuyor.

Kütüphanede sergilenen üç taş, şairin şiirsel anlatılarında yer alan kişisel ve politik yaşamından yola çıkarak değindiği toplumsal trajediler, sürgünler ve yokluk hissi ile olan mücadelesinin aksine, yaşamın özünü ve varoluşun köklerini hissetmeye davet ediyor. Ritsos, betimlemeleri ile, geçmişi şimdi ile bağlarken, insanlık tarihine tanıklık eden yeryüzünün değişmez ve zamanlar ötesi aktörleri olan taşların fısıldakılarına kulak vermemizi ister. Mürekkebinin izlediği her bir girinti bu sessiz nesnelere heykelsi bir nitelik vererek yeryüzünün soğukluğu yerine var oluşun yaşamsal ve sonsuz enerjisini aktarır. İnsanlık tarihini sonsuz bir döngü içerisinde dönen bir küre olarak tahayyül eden Ritsos’un taşları da yaşamsal mücadelenin ve var oluşun sonsuz döngüsünü yansıtırlar.

26 Mayıs – 24 Haziran 2017 tarihleri arasında Galata Rum Okulu’nun dördüncü katında yer alan Açık Okul Kütüphanesinde izleyici ile buluşacak olan ‘’Ve Sadece Taşlar Kaldı’’ aynı zamandan bir seri okuma etkinliğine de ev sahipliği yapacak.

Sanatçının taşlarını göndererek sergiye verdiği destek ve katkıdan dolayı Galata Rum Okulu olarak kızı Eri Ritsos’a sonsuz teşekkürlerimizi sunarız.
events.description_en:
“And Only Stones Remained” presents a small selection of stones painted by Yannis Ritsos, one of the great masters of 20th century Greek poetry, during his exile period on the islands of Yiaros and Leros and afterwards in Samos, where he lived, at the Galata Greek School's Open School Library.

The three stones exhibited in the library invite you to feel the essence of life and the roots of existence, in contrast to the poet's struggle with social tragedies, exiles and the feeling of absence, which he touches upon based on his personal and political life in his poetic narratives. While Ritsos connects the past with the present through his descriptions, he asks us to listen to the whispers of the stones, which are the unchangeable and timeless actors of the earth that bear witness to human history. Each recess traced by his ink gives these silent objects a sculptural quality, conveying the vital and endless energy of existence instead of the coldness of the earth. Ritsos' stones, which imagine human history as a sphere rotating in an endless cycle, reflect the endless cycle of vital struggle and existence.

"And Only Stones Remained", which will meet the audience at the Open School Library on the fourth floor of Galata Greek School between 26 May and 24 June 2017, will also host a series of reading events.

As Galata Greek School, we would like to express our endless gratitude to the artist's daughter Eri Ritsos for her support and contribution to the exhibition by sending her stones.
events.description_el:
Ένα μικρό δείγμα από τις πέτρες που ζωγράφισε κατά την περίοδο εξορίας του στην Γυάρο και στην Λέρο ένας από τους κορυφαίους Έλληνας ποιητές του 20ου αιώνα, ο Γιάννης Ρίτσος, πρόκειται να εκτεθεί στην Ανοικτή Βιβλιοθήκη της Αστικής Σχολής Γαλατά υπό τον τίτλο «Ἒμειναν μόνο οἱ πέτρες.»

Οι τρεις πέτρες που εκτίθενται, σε αντιδιαστολή με την προσωπική και πολιτική τοποθέτηση του ποιητή σχετικά με τις κοινωνικές αδικίες, τις εξορίες και την φτώχια που διαπραγματεύονται τα ποιήματά του, καλούν τους επισκέπτες να αισθανθούν την ουσία της ζωής και τις ρίζες της ύπαρξης του ανθρώπου. Ο Ρίτσος με τις απεικονίσεις του συνδέει το παλιό με το καινούριο και καλεί το κοινό να αφουγκραστεί τον ψίθυρο της πέτρας, ενός υλικού που υπήρξε ο διαχρονικός και αναλλοίωτος μάρτυρας της ιστορίας του ανθρώπου πάνω στην γη. Η κάθε γραμμή που ακολουθεί το μελάνι του, προσδίδει σε αυτό το άψυχο υλικό μια ανάγλυφη πλαστικότητα μεταφέροντας την ατελείωτη ενέργεια της δημιουργίας και της ζωτικότητας. Οι πέτρες αυτές του Ρίτσου, οι οποίες παρουσιάζουν την ιστορία του ανθρώπου ως μία σφαίρα που στροβιλίζεται σε μια αέναη περιστροφή, αντανακλούν την ασταμάτητη περιστροφή του αγώνα της ζωής και της ύπαρξης.

Την έκθεση «Ἒμειναν μόνο οἱ πέτρες» που θα λάβει χώρα στην Ανοιχτή Βιβλιοθήκη του τετάρτου ορόφου της Αστικής Σχολής Γαλατά, μεταξύ 26 Μαΐου -24 Ιουνίου 2017, θα πλαισιώσουν ταυτόχρονα και αναγνώσεις ποιημάτων του καλλιτέχνη.

Ως Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά θα θέλαμε να ευχαριστήσουμε θερμά την κόρη του ποιητή Έρη Ρίτσου για την υποστήριξη που παρείχε στην εν λόγω έκθεση παραχωρώντας αυτά τα έργων τέχνης του πατέρα της.

events.title_en: Leaden Waters: How to Be Brave — Olga Alexopoulou
events.title_el: Μολυβένια Νερά: Πώς να Είσαι Γενναίος — Όλγα Αλεξοπούλου
events.description_tr:
Son yıllarda, çalışmaları müzelerde, sanat galerilerinde ve dünyanın birçok yerinde sokak sanatı olarak duvarlarda sergilenmiş olan Alexopoulou’nun eserleri şimdi de Galata Rum Okulu’nun tarihi atmosferinde yankı bulacak. “Cesur olmak ne anlama gelir?” sorusunun kendine yönelik eleştirel bakışını merkeze alan bu serginin hatlarını kara mürekkep çizimleri, bir adet duvar resmi ve enstalasyon çalışmaları oluşturacaktır. Uyarıcılara doymuş bir dünyada davranışlarımızda nasıl bir yol seçebiliriz? Modern Yunan şairi Andreas Empirikos vakti zamanında “Ve bir hülya anahtarlarıyla açar uzanıp giden ve boyuna büyüyen alemleri, tıpkı fani ve sahte eylemler tarafından sarsılmamış bir yüzeye düşen bir taşın yaydığı dalgacıklar gibi” demiştir. Sergideki çalışmalar da, bu hayali yüzeyin ötesinde var olan bir varoluş biçimini keşfetmek için tahayyülün kendisini kullanır ve izleyeni de kurşuni sular üzerinde düşünceye dalmaya davet eder. Atina, Yunanistan’da doğan Olga Alexopoulou Oxford Üniversitesi Ruskin Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi’nden mezun olmuştur. Şehrin büyüsüne kapıldıktan sonra, on yıldan uzun bir süredir İstanbul’da yaşamaktadır. Eserleri Çin Ningbo, Yunanistan Ulusal Tarih Müzesi ve Bouziani Müzesi gibi yerlerde sergilenmiştir. En son çalışmaları Fransa’da Uluslararası Fransa Duvar Resimleri Bienali’nde (Biennale Internationale d’ Art Mural) sergilenmiştir. 2015 yılında Yunanistan’daki gelmiş geçmiş en büyük duvar resmini tamamlamış ve 2017’de de Londra ve Paris’te çıkan yayınlarda dünyanın en iyi 50 kadın sokak sanatçısından biri olarak addedilmiştir.

Sponsorlar: Istanbul Concept
events.description_en:
Galata Greek School is pleased to present the solo exhibition of Olga Alexopoulou titled “Leaden waters: how to be brave’’ from 20th January to 17th February 2018. In the last years, Alexopoulou whose works have appeared in museums, galleries and as street art on walls around the world will now resonate in the historic context of the Galata Greek School. Black ink drawings, a mural and several installations will make up an exhibition that is a self critical examination of the question: What does it mean to be brave? In a world saturated with stimuli, how can we choose a way to conduct ourselves? The modern Greek poet Andreas Empirikos once wrote: “And the reverie with its keys opens up the horizons, that stretch out and ceaselessly grow, like ripples of a stone that fell on to a surface undisturbed by acts perishable and spurious.” This work uses reverie to discover a way of being beyond the illusory surface and indulges the viewer into a meditation over leaden waters. Olga Alexopoulou, was born in Athens, Greece and is a graduate of the Ruskin School of Art of Oxford University. Over a decade ago, she moved to Istanbul after becoming enchanted by the city. Her works have been exhibited in museums like Ningbo in China, the National History Museum of Greece and the Bouziani Museum. More recently her work was featured in the Biennale Internationale d’ Art Mural of France. In 2015 she completed the largest mural ever painted in Greece, and in 2017 she was included in the 50 best women street artists in the world in publications in London and Paris.

Sponsors: Istanbul Concept
events.description_el:
Από τις 20 Ιανουαρίου έως τις 17 Φεβρουαρίου 2018, η Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά φιλοξένησε την ατομική έκθεση της Όλγας Αλεξοπούλου με τίτλο «Μολυβένια Νερά: Πώς να Είσαι Γενναίος» (Kurşuni Sular: Nasıl Cesur Olunur / Leaden Waters: How to Be Brave).

Μετά από παρουσιάσεις έργων της σε μουσεία, γκαλερί και δημόσιους τοίχους ανά τον κόσμο, η δουλειά της Αλεξοπούλου συνδιαλέγεται με την ιστορική ατμόσφαιρα της Σχολής Γαλατά. Σχέδια με μαύρη μελάνη, μία τοιχογραφία και εγκαταστάσεις συνθέτουν μια έκθεση που θέτει στο επίκεντρο το αυτοκριτικό ερώτημα: «Τι σημαίνει να είσαι γενναίος; Πώς μπορούμε να επιλέξουμε τη στάση μας σε έναν κόσμο κορεσμένο από ερεθίσματα;»

Όπως έγραψε ο ποιητής Ανδρέας Εμπειρίκος: «Καὶ ἡ ὀνειροπόλησις μὲ τὰ κλειδιά της ἀνοίγει τοὺς ὁρίζοντας ποὺ ἁπλώνονται καὶ διαρκῶς μεγαλώνουν, σὰν κύκλοι λίθου ποὺ ἔπεσε σὲ ἐπιφάνεια ἀδιατάρακτη ἀπὸ πράξεις φθαρτὲς καὶ νόθες». Τα έργα της έκθεσης αξιοποιούν την ονειροπόληση για να ανακαλύψουν έναν τρόπο ύπαρξης πέρα από την απατηλή επιφάνεια, προσκαλώντας τον θεατή σε έναν στοχασμό πάνω στα μολυβένια νερά.

Γεννημένη στην Αθήνα, η Όλγα Αλεξοπούλου αποφοίτησε από τη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών Ruskin του Πανεπιστημίου της Οξφόρδης. Γοητευμένη από την Κωνσταντινούπολη, εγκαταστάθηκε στην πόλη όπου ζει και εργάζεται για περισσότερο από μία δεκαετία. Έργα της έχουν εκτεθεί μεταξύ άλλων στο Μουσείο Τέχνης Ningbo στην Κίνα, στο Εθνικό Ιστορικό Μουσείο στην Αθήνα, στο Μουσείο Μπουζιάνη και στη Διεθνή Μπιενάλε Τοιχογραφίας της Γαλλίας (Biennale Internationale d’Art Mural). Το 2015 ολοκλήρωσε τη μεγαλύτερη τοιχογραφία που είχε φιλοτεχνηθεί έως τότε στην Ελλάδα και το 2017 συμπεριλήφθηκε στις 50 κορυφαίες γυναίκες street artists παγκοσμίως σε εκδόσεις στο Λονδίνο και το Παρίσι.

Υποστήριξη: Istanbul Concept

events.title_en: İmtidâd (Continuity) — Lara Ögel
events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu, 20 Ocak – 17 Şubat 2018 tarihleri arasında bir proje ve okuma odası olarak yürüttüğü ve okulun 4.katında yer alan Açık Okul Kütüphanesin’de Lara Ögel’in ‘’İmtidâd ‘’ adlı sergisini ağırlamaktan mutluluk duyar. Geçmişin ve geleceğin harmanlanmış bulanık tonları arasında tanıdık bir an yakalamaya çalışır gibi sayfaları karıştırıyordu parmakları… öyle ki bu arayışı, önündeki bulanık diyarda uzadıkça uzadı … zamansızlık onu sarıp sarmaladı… …ta ki görünmeyen olan kendini görünür kılana kadar…

İşlerinde mekan ve hafıza kavramlarına incelikli bir bakış açısı getiren Lara Ögel, Galata Rum Okulundaki sergisinde bu olgulara mekana özgü bir yerleştirme ile cevap veriyor. Arafta olan veya durmuş olan zaman dilimlerinin izinden giden Ögel, sergide Yahya Kemal’in kültür hayatımıza kazandırdığı ve öğrencisi olan Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar’ın da ‘‘devam ederek değişmek, değişerek devam etmek’’ olarak tanımladığı bir kavram olan İmtidâd kelimesine odaklanmaktadır. Modernizmin getirdiği değişim ve dönüşüm süreci içerisinde kendi olarak kalabilmeyi de irdeleyen bu tanımı sanatçı, geçmişten bugüne, zamanın devinimiyle kendi kalma yolculuğunu yaşayan Galata Rum Okulu’nun belleğiyle harmanlıyor.

Ögel, mekanın eski aktörleri olan çocukların bıraktığı izleri takip ederek, izleyiciyi bu keşif alanına davet ediyor.
events.description_en:
Galata Greek School is pleased to present Lara Ögel’s exhibition titled ’İmtidâd ‘ at Open School Library initiated as a reading room and project space.

Through the blurred shades that blend the past and the future, her fingers were flipping the pages as if to find a familiar moment… such was the search that went on and on amongst the blurry realm ahead of her… timelessness embraced her… … until that which is unseen has revealed itself

Lara Ögel whose artworks introduce a refined perspective on space and memory, answers these concepts through a site-aware installation for her show at Galata Greek School. Following the traces left behind from states of uncertainty or suspension, Ögel focuses on the term İmtidâd; brought into our culture by Yahya Kemal and defined by his pupil Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar as “to evolve as you go on and to go on as you evolve”. The artist harmonizes this definition, which also examines the state of staying true to one’s self in the course of evolution and progress that Modernism imposes, with the memory of Galata Greek School which is going through similar motions.

Ögel is inviting the viewer to a site of exploration, following the clues left behind by the students that are amongst the past actors of the space.
events.description_el:
Από τις 20 Ιανουαρίου έως τις 17 Φεβρουαρίου 2018, η Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά φιλοξένησε στην Ανοιχτή Σχολική Βιβλιοθήκη του 4ου ορόφου την ατομική έκθεση της Lara Ögel με τίτλο «İmtidâd» (Διηνεκές / Συνέχεια).

«Ανάμεσα στους θολούς τόνους όπου το παρελθόν και το μέλλον σμίγουν, τα δάχτυλά της ξεφύλλιζαν τις σελίδες σαν να αναζητούσαν μια γνώριμη στιγμή… ώσπου η διαχρονικότητα την τύλιξε… μέχρι που το αόρατο έγινε ορατό…»

Προσεγγίζοντας με λεπτότητα τις έννοιες του χώρου και της μνήμης, η Lara Ögel απαντά στην ιστορία της Σχολής Γαλατά με μια εγκατάσταση ειδικά σχεδιασμένη για τον χώρο (site-specific). Ακολουθώντας τα ίχνη μετέωρων ή παγωμένων χρονικών στιγμών, η καλλιτέχνιδα εστιάζει στην έννοια «İmtidâd» — έναν όρο που εισήγαγε ο ποιητής Yahya Kemal Beyatlı και όρισε ο μαθητής του Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar ως «το να αλλάζεις συνεχίζοντας και να συνεχίζεις αλλάζοντας». Η Ögel συνενώνει αυτή την έννοια της συνέχειας μέσα στον μετασχηματισμό με τη μνήμη της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά, προσκαλώντας τον επισκέπτη σε ένα πεδίο ανακάλυψης μέσα από τα ίχνη που άφησαν οι μαθητές, οι παλαιοί πρωταγωνιστές του χώρου.

events.title_en: Procedural Reality — Ömer Pekin
events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu , 31 Ocak – 17 Şubat 2018 tarihleri arasında Avusturya Liseliler Vakfı’nın düzenlediği, Ömer Pekin ‘in “ Prosedürel Gerçeklik ” adlı çağdaş sanat sergisini ağırlamaktan mutluluk duyar. Ömer Pekin, dijital ortamda geliştirilmiş mimari kompozisyınları sanatsal boyutta incelemek için kendi geliştirdiği yazılımlar aracılığıyla resimler yaratıyor. Yazılımları sanat ve mimari arasında görsel bir pratik tanımlayarak her seferinde birbirinden farklı formlar yaratmayı amaçlıyor. Bunu yaparken dijital kaynaklara geçici bir maddesellik vererek analog resim yapma teknikleriyle ilişkilerini inceliyor. “Prosedürel Gerçeklik” isimli enstalasyon insan boyutlarında, izleyicilerin etrafında gezinebildiği, neredeyse içine girerek deneyimleyebileceği özgün cam objelerden oluşuyor. Cam objelerin üzerine ikincil bir katman olarak yannsıtılan dijital resimler objelerin ruhu olarak işlev görüyor ve onllarla etkileşime geçiyor. Bu durumda izleyicinin bir resmin içine girmeyi deneyimleyebilmesi ve içine girdiği mekanın bir parçası olduğunu alışılmışın dışında algılayabilmesi amaçlanıyor. Bu proje hem materyal hem de mekan kavramını algı üzerinden yeniden tanımlarken, mimarlık ile sanatın birbirlerini ayıran sınırlarını zorluyor.

Ömer Pekin 1991 İstanbul’da doğdu. Eğitimini Avusturya’daki Akademie der bildenen Künste Wien’de gerçekleştiren Pekin, yüksek lisansını SCI-Arc, Southern California Institute of Architecture’da tamamlamıştır. Ömer Pekin dijital ortamda geliştirilmiş mimari kompozisyonları sanatsal boyutta incelemek için kendi geliştirdiği yazılımlar aracılığıyla resimler yaratıyor. Yazılımları sanat ve mimari arasında görsel bir pratik tanımlayarak her seferinde birbirinden farklı formlar yaratmayı amaçlıyor. Bunu yaparken, Ömer dijital kaynaklara geçici bir maddesellik vererek analog resim yapma teknikleriyle ilişkilerini inceliyor. Amacı fiziksel nitelikle dijital sonucun arasındaki ilişkiyi sorgulayarak, her biri form ve kalıp açısından ayrı estetikleri olan farklı gerçeklikler yaratmaktır. Sanatçı İstanbul’da yaşıyor ve çalışıyor.
events.description_en:
The Galata Greek School is pleased to host the contemporary art exhibition "Procedural Reality" by Ömer Pekin, organized by the Austrian High School Alumni Foundation (Avusturya Liseliler Vakfı) from January 31 to February 17, 2018.

Ömer Pekin creates paintings and visual works through custom software he developed to explore digitally generated architectural compositions on an artistic plane. Defining a visual practice at the intersection of art and architecture, his software generates distinct forms with every iteration, lending digital sources a temporary materiality and examining their relationship with analog painting techniques. The installation "Procedural Reality" consists of human-scale, bespoke glass objects around which viewers can circulate and almost step inside to experience. Digital paintings projected onto the glass objects as a secondary layer act as their spirit and interact with them, allowing the viewer to experience stepping inside a painting and perceiving themselves as part of the space in an unconventional way. Redefining both material and space through perception, the project challenges the boundaries separating architecture and art.

Born in Istanbul in 1991, Ömer Pekin studied at the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna (Akademie der bildenden Künste Wien) in Austria and earned his master's degree at SCI-Arc (Southern California Institute of Architecture) in Los Angeles. Questioning the relationship between physical quality and digital outcome, Pekin creates distinct realities with their own formal and structural aesthetics. The artist lives and works in Istanbul.
events.description_el:
Η Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά φιλοξενεί με χαρά την έκθεση σύγχρονης τέχνης του Ömer Pekin με τίτλο «Διαδικαστική Πραγματικότητα» (Procedural Reality), που διοργανώθηκε από το Ίδρυμα Αποφοίτων της Αυστριακής Σχολής (Avusturya Liseliler Vakfı) από τις 31 Ιανουαρίου έως τις 17 Φεβρουαρίου 2018.

Ο Ömer Pekin δημιουργεί εικαστικά έργα μέσω εξειδικευμένου λογισμικού που ανέπτυξε ο ίδιος, διερευνώντας σε καλλιτεχνικό επίπεδο αρχιτεκτονικές συνθέσεις που αναπτύσσονται σε ψηφιακό περιβάλλον. Ορίζοντας μια οπτική πρακτική στη τομή τέχνης και αρχιτεκτονικής, το λογισμικό του παράγει κάθε φορά διαφορετικές μορφές, προσδίδοντας στις ψηφιακές πηγές μια πρόσκαιρη υλικότητα και εξετάζοντας τη σχέση τους με τις αναλογικές τεχνικές ζωγραφικής. Η εγκατάσταση «Διαδικαστική Πραγματικότητα» αποτελείται από αυθεντικά γυάλινα αντικείμενα σε ανθρώπινη κλίμακα, γύρω από τα οποία οι θεατές μπορούν να περιηγηθούν και σχεδόν να εισέλθουν στο εσωτερικό τους. Οι ψηφιακές εικόνες που προβάλλονται ως δεύτερο επίπεδο πάνω στο γυαλί λειτουργούν ως η «ψυχή» των αντικειμένων και αλληλεπιδρούν μαζί τους, επιτρέποντας στον επισκέπτη να βιώσει την είσοδο μέσα σε έναν πίνακα και να αντιληφθεί τον εαυτό του ως μέρος του χώρου.

Γεννημένος στην Κωνσταντινούπολη το 1991, ο Ömer Pekin σπούδασε στην Ακαδημία Καλών Τεχνών της Βιέννης (Akademie der bildenden Künste Wien) και ολοκλήρωσε τις μεταπτυχιακές του σπουδές στο SCI-Arc (Southern California Institute of Architecture) στο Λος Άντζελες. Αμφισβητώντας τη σχέση μεταξύ φυσικής υλικότητας και ψηφιακού αποτελέσματος, δημιουργεί πολλαπλές πραγματικότητες με διακριτή μορφική αισθητική. Ο καλλιτέχνης ζει και εργάζεται στην Κωνσταντινούπολη.

events.title_en: First Round — Selections from the Çarmıklı Collection
events.title_el: Πρώτος Γύρος — Επιλογές από τη Συλλογή Çarmıklı
events.description_tr:
Çarmıklı Koleksiyonu’ndan kapsamlı bir seçki sunan “İlk Raunt”, sanatseverlerle yaşanacak heyecanlı bir karşılaşmanın zilini çalıyor. Galata Rum Okulu’nda 6 Mart – 12 Mayıs tarihleri arasında izleyiciyle buluşacak olan sergi; pentürden enstalasyona, fotoğraftan videoya kadar farklı disiplinlerdeki çalışmalar üzerinden yerel çağdaş sanat pratiğinin son dönemine dair çok katmanlı bir okuma vadediyor.

Toplumsal duyarlılık alanlarından beslenen, yaratıcısının bireysel eğiliminin özgün ve özgürlüğü mertebesinde vücut bulmuş 100’e yakın yapıtın bir araya getirildiği “İlk Raunt”; koleksiyoncu ve koleksiyon kimliğinin ötesinde derinleşen bütünsel söylemini izleyiciyle paylaşıyor. Çeşitli medyumlardan işlerin ortaya konduğu seçki; yıllar boyu titizlikle örülmüş bir fikir ve arayış serüvenini gözler önüne seriyor. Koleksiyoncunun; doğrudan üzerine aldığı küratoryal sorumluluk ile kendi gözünden hikâyeleştirdiği bu serüven, her katta ve odada yepyeni diyalog ve açılımların sınırını zorluyor. Türkiye’de kavramsal sanatın mihenk taşı sayılabilecek isimler ile sanat piyasasının ışıklarından uzakta kalmış aykırı, yenilikçi ve derdini üretimine dökmüş genç yeteneklerin tek bir çatı altında toplandığı sergi, halen güncelliğini koruyan konulara dair keskin ve ortak bir eleştirel bakışın ürünü olarak öne çıkıyor.

Toplumsal travmalarımıza her gün bir yenisinin eklendiği bu yoğun gündemde; bireysel varoluş mücadelesi, cinsiyet ve kimlik politikaları, aile içi şiddet, erk iktidarı, kadın hakları, namus, geleneksel-çağdaş ikilemi gibi meselelerde sözünü sakınmayan 70’ten fazla sanatçının yapıtları, serginin baş rol oyuncuları olarak taçlandırılıyor.

“İlk Raunt”, vicdani sorumluluk sınırlarını yeniden belirlemeye giden kapıları açabilmek adına; tüm cesaretiyle, birlikte ringe çıkan sanatçı ve koleksiyoncunun güç birliğine vurgu yapıyor. Sergi süresince; panel, tematik tur ve performans gibi etkinliklerle mekâna dinamizm katacak olan seçki; sanatseverleri, bu maça katılmaya davet ediyor.
events.description_en:
Presenting an extensive selection from the Çarmıklı Collection, “First Round” (İlk Raunt) rang the bell for an engaging encounter with art lovers at the Galata Greek School between March 6 and May 12, 2018. Spanning painting, installation, photography, and video, the exhibition offered a multi-layered reading of contemporary art practices in Turkey.

Bringing together nearly 100 works by more than 70 artists nourished by social conscience and individual artistic freedom, “First Round” shared a holistic curatorial narrative shaped directly through the collector’s own perspective across every floor and room of the historic school building. Alongside pioneering figures of conceptual art in Turkey, the exhibition spotlighted innovative emerging artists addressing urgent themes including individual existence, gender and identity politics, domestic violence, power structures, women’s rights, and the tension between tradition and modernity.

Emphasizing the solidarity of artist and collector stepping into the ring together to redefine the boundaries of moral responsibility, the exhibition was accompanied by a dynamic public program of panels, thematic tours, and performances.
events.description_el:
Παρουσιάζοντας μια εκτενή επιλογή έργων από τη Συλλογή Çarmıklı, η έκθεση «Πρώτος Γύρος» (İlk Raunt) φιλοξενήθηκε στην Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά από τις 6 Μαρτίου έως τις 12 Μαΐου 2018. Μέσα από έργα ζωγραφικής, εγκαταστάσεις, φωτογραφία και βίντεο, η έκθεση πρότεινε μια πολυεπίπεδη ανάγνωση της σύγχρονης εικαστικής δημιουργίας στην Τουρκία.

Συγκεντρώνοντας σχεδόν 100 έργα περισσότερων από 70 καλλιτεχνών, ο «Πρώτος Γύρος» ανέδειξε μια συνεκτική επιμελητική αφήγηση σε όλους τους ορόφους και τις αίθουσες του ιστορικού διδακτηρίου. Δίπλα σε εμβληματικούς εκπροσώπους της εννοιολογικής τέχνης στην Τουρκία, η έκθεση έφερε στο προσκήνιο αντισυμβατικούς νέους δημιουργούς που τοποθετούνται κριτικά απέναντι σε επίκαιρα κοινωνικά ζητήματα, όπως ο αγώνας της ατομικής ύπαρξης, οι πολιτικές φύλου και ταυτότητας, η ενδοοικογενειακή βία, η εξουσία, τα δικαιώματα των γυναικών και το δίπολο παράδοσης–νεωτερικότητας.

Τονίζοντας τη σύμπραξη καλλιτέχνη και συλλέκτη που ανεβαίνουν μαζί στο ρινγκ για να επαναπροσδιορίσουν τα όρια της ηθικής ευθύνης, η έκθεση πλαισιώθηκε από πάνελ, θεματικές ξεναγήσεις και παραστάσεις.
